variables.psi: one canonical complex fundamental vector per node
variables.chi: one independent canonical complex conjugate-representation vector per node; explicit addition
variables.U: unitary r by r matrix per incidence link
variables.E: Hermitian left cotangent momentum per link

parameters.rank: arbitrary integer r>=1, not physically selected
parameters.mu: >=0; internal phase coefficient, not established rest mass

units: dimensionless internal time; physical clock/action units OPEN
Hamiltonian: a/2 sum tr(E^2) + kappa sum_d(1-Re tr(W_d)/r) + psi^dagger(mu I+h_U)psi + chi^dagger(mu I+bar(h_U))chi
Gauss: sum_head E - sum_tail U^dagger E U - psi psi^dagger + bar(chi)chi^T =0
admissible_nonzero_data: chi=bar(psi), E=0, arbitrary unitary U; initial preparation only
verification: constructor checks plus written universal proofs; not independent review
